_meta.title: Industry domain graph — connectivity remediation (PROPOSAL ONLY)
_meta.purpose: Grounded feedback/reciprocal edges and redundant paths to remediate the findings from assets/js/energy-connectivity-audit.js (the audit module is domain-generic) run against assets/data/domains/industry.json. This is a recommendation artifact; it does NOT modify any live graph.
_meta.discipline: Every proposed edge carries a concrete grounding (a canonical-nodes.json regulatory fact OR the reciprocity of an existing industry.json edge). Candidates that could not be grounded are omitted and tallied under _omittedForLackOfGrounding.
_meta.doNotApply: Do not merge these edges into assets/data/domains/industry.json without an explicit apply step.
_meta.neuroReferenceThesis: Healthy circuits are ~80% recurrent/lateral; the network, not the node, is the unit of failure (diaschisis). A pure feedforward tree is the broken/cosmetic version.
_meta.pathologyVerdict: SAME core signature as Energy/Finance, with the OPPOSITE component fault to Finance. Industry shows the identical feedforward pathology: ZERO reciprocal/feedback edges (recurrentFraction 0) despite carrying directed control rings, and many single points of failure (10 articulation nodes). UNLIKE Finance: the graph is a SINGLE connected component at baseline (baseComponents 1, like Energy) — Industry does NOT have Finance's disconnected {M1, SMA} dyad, because SMA->M1 + M1->THAL keep the motor pair inside the main body. EXTRA relative to Finance: one more articulation node (10 vs 9) — OFC is the sole bridge of the reward island {NAcc, VTA, VP}, which in Finance had independent attachments; here that island hangs off OFC alone.

recurrenceAudit.note: ZERO reciprocal/feedback edges — the same feedforward-only signature the neuro reference calls the broken version. The graph carries directed cycles (e.g. the business ring M1->dACC->S1->HYPO->CBLM->AG->M1 via CONTROLS/DEPENDS_ON), but for no edge A->B does B->A exist, so recurrentFraction is exactly 0. verdict from the module = 'has recurrent/lateral structure' only because lateralFractionOfClassifiable (0.353) clears the 0.2 lateral threshold; the feedback dimension is fully absent. The 12 lateral edges are the intra-group SUPPLIES chains (manufacturing, quality, chemical, automation) plus dlPFC->HIPP and SMA->M1.

singlePointsOfFailure.baseComponentsNote: ONE component at baseline (all 36 edge-incident nodes weakly connected). This is the OPPOSITE of Finance (baseComponents=2): Industry's SMA->M1 + M1->THAL + dlPFC->SMA keep the motor pair attached, so there is no disconnected dyad. (TPJ, DMN, PRECUNEUS, WERN are activations but appear in no edge, so they are outside the audit's edge-induced node set entirely.)
singlePointsOfFailure.topHubsNote: Three-way tie at degree 7 (THAL, dACC, S1) and a further tie at degree 6 (M1, CeA, BLA); the module slices the top 5 after a stable descending sort.

mechanismOfEachArticulation.THAL: sole attachment of the visual island {V1, LGN, FEF} (via THAL->V1; V1's other neighbours LGN and FEF are both leaves) AND the auditory island {A1, MGN} (THAL->A1; MGN is a leaf of A1). NOTE: unlike Finance, the visual island DOES hang off THAL here, because FEF is only a leaf of V1 (FEF->V1 is FEF's only edge) and does not anchor V1 independently. NOTE: THAL does NOT isolate S1 or CBLM here (both are richly connected), so THAL is de-articulable once the two sensory islands are reattached.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.V1: sole attachment of leaf LGN (LGN->V1 is LGN's only edge) and leaf FEF (FEF->V1 is FEF's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.A1: sole attachment of leaf MGN (MGN->A1 is MGN's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.AI: sole attachment of leaves NTS (NTS->AI only) and PI (PI->AI only).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.dACC: sole bridge of the interoceptive island {AI, NTS, PI} to the main body — AI->dACC is that island's only link out.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.vmPFC: sole attachment of leaf PAG (vmPFC->PAG is PAG's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.HIPP: sole attachment of leaf HPA (HPA->HIPP is HPA's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.NAcc: sole attachment of leaves VTA (VTA->NAcc only) and VP (NAcc->VP only) — the two reward leaves.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.BLA: sole attachment of leaf rACC (rACC->BLA is rACC's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.OFC: EXTRA vs Finance: sole bridge of the whole reward island {NAcc, VTA, VP} to the main body — NAcc->OFC is that island's only link out. In Finance NAcc had additional main-body attachments; in Industry it hangs off OFC alone, so OFC becomes an articulation point.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the thalamo-cortico-thalamic somatosensory loop that THAL->S1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->S1 (excit, somatosensory relay). Layer-6 corticothalamic feedback S1->VPL is one of the most numerous projection classes in the brain (feedback outnumbers feedforward), functionally gain/precision control -> modul. canonical-nodes S1 = 'primary somatosensory processing', THAL = motif M4 'gating relay / routing'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the visual thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->V1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->V1 (excit, visual sensory relay). V1->LGN/pulvinar corticothalamic feedback is canonical and modulatory. canonical-nodes V1 = 'primary visual processing'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the auditory thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->A1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->A1 (excit, auditory sensory relay). A1->MGN corticothalamic feedback is canonical and modulatory. canonical-nodes A1 = 'primary auditory processing'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the conflict-monitoring -> cognitive-control loop: the quality/error signal feeds back to the executive (workforce management) to adjust control gain.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge dlPFC->dACC (excit). canonical-nodes dACC = M6 'conflict/error monitor', dlPFC = 'dorsolateral PFC — executive working-memory / cognitive control'. dACC<->dlPFC are reciprocally connected (Botvinick conflict-control loop).

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the salience-network loop; the two salience hubs (quality-control monitor + internal-telemetry insula) must be mutually coupled to co-select what gets escalated.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge AI->dACC (excit, 'interoceptive -> conflict monitor'). canonical-nodes AI = M10 'interoceptive salience'; the anterior insula and dorsal ACC are the two defining hubs of the salience network and are reciprocally coupled by definition.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the value<->context loop; the context/valuation brake feeds back onto outcome valuation (standards & compliance). Reciprocal of the existing OFC->vmPFC edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge OFC->vmPFC (excit). canonical-nodes vmPFC = M1 'top-down inhibitory brake', OFC = M6 'outcome valuation / update'; they are adjacent medial/orbital PFC regions with dense reciprocal connectivity.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the valuation<->reward loop; the outcome-valuation stage feeds forward-and-back to the reward driver. Reciprocal of the existing NAcc->OFC edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge NAcc->OFC (excit). The orbitofrontal cortex is a principal glutamatergic corticostriatal input to the ventral striatum / nucleus accumbens (canonical OFC->NAcc projection). canonical-nodes OFC = M6 valuation, NAcc = M11 'incentive/reward drive'. NOTE: this same edge is load-bearing in the redundancy plan — see proposedRedundantPaths, because OFC is the sole bridge of the reward island.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: INDUSTRY-SPECIFIC closure of the motor hierarchy loop: assembly-line execution feeds back to heavy-equipment planning/sequencing. Reciprocal of the existing SMA->M1 edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge SMA->M1 (excit, 'planned movement -> execution'). canonical-nodes M1 = 'primary motor cortex — motor output', SMA = 'supplementary motor — self-initiated action sequencing'; M1 and SMA are densely reciprocally connected in the cortical motor hierarchy.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: INDUSTRY-SPECIFIC closure of the frontoparietal control loop: the executive (workforce management) feeds back to the precision-machining fronto-parietal controller. Reciprocal of the existing FPN->dlPFC edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge FPN->dlPFC (excit, 'fronto-parietal -> executive'). canonical-nodes dlPFC = executive control; FPN = control-network view (dlPFC+IPS). The frontoparietal control network is defined by reciprocal dlPFC<->parietal loops. NOTE: canonical-nodes marks FPN as a COMPOSITE view; the cleaner long-run fix is to remap FPN's parietal component (IPS) as the concrete endpoint.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Gives the auditory cortex a cortical anchor off the THAL hub, reattaching the auditory relay island {A1, MGN} to the main body when THAL is removed. Paired with FEF->dlPFC below (which reattaches the visual island), this drops THAL from the articulation set.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes AI = M10 'interoceptive salience'; auditory cortex projects to the insular cortex (auditory-to-insula projection is documented; the insula integrates auditory salience).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: The visual island reaches the main body only through THAL->V1 (FEF is merely a leaf of V1 here). A frontal-eye-field -> executive edge gives the island a second bridge via FEF; removing THAL then leaves {V1, LGN, FEF} attached through FEF->dlPFC. Combined with A1->AI, this fully de-articulates THAL.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes FEF = 'frontal eye fields — attentional gaze control', dlPFC = executive control. FEF and dlPFC are both frontal nodes of the dorsal-attention / executive system with dense reciprocal connectivity (FEF is a core dorsal-attention hub projecting to lateral PFC).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: AI splits into two leaves on removal: PI (PI->AI only) and NTS (NTS->AI only). This edge reattaches the PI leaf: a posterior-insula -> cingulate interoceptive edge gives PI a second anchor. Paired with NTS->PVN below, it fully de-articulates AI.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes PI = M10 'primary interoception', dACC = M6 conflict monitor / salience hub. Posterior/mid-insula interoceptive signals project to the anterior cingulate as part of the interoception-salience pathway.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Reattaches AI's second leaf, NTS (NTS->AI only). A visceral-afferent -> hypothalamus edge gives NTS a second anchor; removing AI then leaves NTS attached via PVN. Together with PI->dACC this drops AI from the articulation set.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes NTS = M10 'visceral afferent hub'. The nucleus tractus solitarius sends a canonical ascending projection to the paraventricular nucleus of the hypothalamus (visceral-afferent -> autonomic/neuroendocrine relay). PVN is already an in-graph node (target of BLA->PVN, HIPP->PVN, mPFC->PVN, LC->PVN; source of PVN->HYPO). NOTE: PVN is not itself catalogued in canonical-nodes.json, but it is an established in-graph endpoint.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: The interoceptive island reaches the main body only via AI->dACC, so removing dACC isolates the whole island. An anterior-insula -> orbitofrontal edge gives the island a second bridge; removing dACC then leaves {AI, NTS, PI} attached via OFC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: The anterior insula projects to the orbitofrontal cortex, carrying interoceptive/gustatory signal into valuation (canonical insula->OFC pathway). canonical-nodes AI = M10 interoceptive salience, OFC = M6 valuation.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: PAG reaches the graph only via vmPFC->PAG, so removing vmPFC isolates it. A central-amygdala -> PAG efferent gives PAG a second afferent; removing vmPFC then leaves PAG attached via CeA. Also closes the threat-appraisal -> defensive-output (safety-systems) pathway.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes CeA = M7 'phasic fear output'; PAG = M8 'defensive kill/lockdown'. The central-amygdala -> periaqueductal-gray projection is the textbook fear-output pathway.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: HPA reaches the graph only via HPA->HIPP, so removing HIPP isolates it. Cortisol also acts on the amygdala, giving HPA a second, well-grounded anchor; removing HIPP then leaves HPA attached via BLA.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: Glucocorticoid (HPA-axis) output acts on the basolateral amygdala via glucocorticoid receptors, enhancing threat processing (textbook stress endocrinology). canonical-nodes BLA = M7 'threat learning/acquisition'. NOTE: canonical-nodes marks HPA as a COMPOSITE view (HYPO->PIT loop, 'not an edge endpoint'); the cleaner long-run fix is to remap HPA to a view rather than treat it as a node.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Reattaches VP to VTA and closes the mesolimbic reward loop (VTA->NAcc->VP->VTA), so the hedonic-output stage feeds back to regulate the dopamine source. NOTE: VP->VTA alone does NOT fully de-articulate NAcc, because both VTA and VP still reach the main body only through NAcc; the VTA->STRI edge below supplies the reward island's independent main-body anchor, and the two edges together de-articulate NAcc.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: In-graph the reward chain VTA->NAcc (excit) and NAcc->VP (inhib) already exists; the ventral pallidum sends GABAergic feedback to VTA (canonical mesolimbic disinhibition loop). canonical-nodes VP = 'ventral pallidum — reward/hedonic output', VTA = M11 'dopamine reward source'.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: The reward island reaches the main body only through NAcc->OFC (making OFC an articulation node) and internally only through NAcc (making NAcc an articulation node for VTA/VP). A dopaminergic VTA -> striatum edge gives the island a SECOND, independent bridge to the main body (STRI is a main-body hub): removing OFC leaves the island attached via VTA->STRI, and combined with VP->VTA it also de-articulates NAcc.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes VTA = M11 'dopamine reward source', STRI = striatum composite view (CAUD+PUT+NAcc). The VTA/midbrain-dopamine mesostriatal projection to the striatum is one of the most canonical projections in the brain. NOTE: canonical-nodes marks STRI as a COMPOSITE view; the concrete dorsal-striatal endpoint (CAUD/PUT) would be the cleaner target.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: rACC reaches the graph only via rACC->BLA, so removing BLA isolates it. A medial-PFC affective-regulation edge gives rACC a second anchor; removing BLA then leaves rACC attached via vmPFC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes rACC = 'rostral ACC — affective appraisal & regulation', vmPFC = M1 top-down brake. rACC and vmPFC are adjacent ventromedial affective-regulation regions with reciprocal connectivity (the emotion-regulation medial-PFC cluster).

projectedImpact.method: The 19 proposed edges (9 feedback + 10 redundant/reconnection) were appended to a deep copy of industry.json in memory and re-scored with assets/js/energy-connectivity-audit.js. industry.json itself was NOT modified.

reciprocalEdges.note: the 9 reciprocal pairs are exactly the 9 proposedFeedbackEdges (each is the reverse of a pre-existing edge); none of the 10 redundant edges creates a reciprocal pair.

recurrentFraction.note: 18/81 = 0.222 crosses the 0.2 tree-vs-mesh threshold — identical to the Finance projection, since both graphs are 62->81 edges with 9 new reciprocal pairs.

baseComponents.note: UNCHANGED — Industry is already a single connected component at baseline (no disconnected dyad to repair, unlike Finance which went 2->1). The reconnection edges here de-articulate rather than re-join.

lateralEdges.note: only M1->SMA adds an intra-group (manufacturing) lateral edge; the other 18 additions are cross-group or involve non-activation endpoints.

articulationNodes.reason: THAL is FULLY de-articulated (A1->AI reattaches the auditory island, FEF->dlPFC reattaches the visual island, and THAL does not gate any other leaf). AI, dACC, vmPFC, HIPP, NAcc, OFC, BLA are each de-articulated by their listed redundant path(s). The two residual articulation points survive solely because a dedicated sensory relay leaf has no second grounded projection target present in the graph, so its redundant path was omitted rather than fabricated: V1 still cuts off LGN; A1 still cuts off MGN. This is the same honest floor Energy and Finance bottomed out at for the identical LGN/MGN reason. NOTE: Industry ends at 2 residual articulations, one fewer than Finance's 3 (Finance kept THAL residual for its S1/CBLM leaves; in Industry S1 and CBLM are richly connected, so THAL clears).

candidates.candidate: redundant path around V1 via a second edge on LGN
candidates.reason: LGN is a dedicated retino-recipient thalamic relay whose only cortical target is V1; the pulvinar / superior-colliculus partners that would give it a second grounded projection are not present as nodes in the industry graph. LGN stays a leaf of V1, so V1 remains a residual articulation point.

candidates.candidate: redundant path around A1 via a second edge on MGN
candidates.reason: MGN is a dedicated cochlea-recipient (medial geniculate) auditory thalamic relay whose only cortical target is A1; no second grounded projection target exists among the graph's nodes. MGN stays a leaf of A1, so A1 remains a residual articulation point.

Hippocampal output to lateral PFC is not a monosynaptic projection; direct hippocampal-PFC fibers target mPFC/vmPFC, not dlPFC, and the mPFC relay is not on an industry-graph edge path. Cannot ground a direct HIPP->dlPFC edge.

The thalamus does not project to the cerebellum; cerebellar cortical input arrives polysynaptically via the pontine nuclei (no direct thalamus->cerebellum fiber). The CBLM->THAL edge therefore has no groundable reciprocal. (Finance omitted the analogous CBLM redundancy for the same anatomical reason.)

_omittedForLackOfGrounding.notedButNotOmitted: A second anchor for THAL's sensory islands via S1 (S1->M1, densely reciprocal somatomotor connectivity) is groundable, but was not needed: A1->AI and FEF->dlPFC already clear THAL from the articulation set, and S1 is not a THAL leaf here. Recorded as a groundable future edge, not an omission for lack of grounding.
